questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement’.**

Over the past 20 years, there __has been__ a constant decline in the variety of vegetables that we eat because the native varieties are no longer available.
questions.solution:

__
 
• The present perfect tense is a verb tense that shows an action or state that either occurred at an indefinite time in the past or began in the past and continued to the present time.
 
• The structure is given below:
 
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + object. (active voice)
 
• Object + has/have + been + V3 + subject. (passive voice)
 
 
 
• ​Example:
 
 
• *​He has played some matches for the Indian Cricket team. (active voice)*
 
• *Some matches have been played by him for the Indian Cricket team. (passive voice)*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, we need to follow the structure in the active voice form.
 
• Since the given sentence talks about the action that continues till the present time, 'has been' is the most appropriate choice of the verb form in the** underlined part.**
 
• Thus we are left with the 1st option as the only correct choice.

 

Correct Sentence__: *Over the past 20 years, there **has been** a constant decline in the variety of vegetables that we eat because the native varieties are no longer available.*
